description: This Java class 'AliasesAppender' extends a configuration object by adding alias keys based on environment variable settings. It reads alias mappings from a JSON string environment variable, and applies these aliases to an existing configuration, allowing fallback to original values.

classes.name: AliasesAppender
classes.description: A final class implementing UnaryOperator<Config> that adds alias keys to a Config object based on environment variable JSON mappings.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates an AliasesAppender instance using environment variable CONFIG_ALIASES for alias mappings.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies alias mappings to the provided Config object, returning a new Config with added aliases.

methods.name: parseString
methods.description: Parses a JSON string from environment variable into a Map of alias to original key.

methods.name: tryToGetOriginalValueOrNull
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the value for an original key from Config, handling exceptions.

methods.name: getOriginalValueOrNull
methods.description: Retrieves the ConfigValue for a given key from Config.
